_meta.description: budget-known-costs — BudgetLineDerivation, the idempotency + override ledger for known-cost regeneration. Written only by KnownCostBudgetWriter, one row per (annualBudgetId, ledgerGroupId, sourceType) triple that has ever been machine-generated. See openspec/changes/budget-known-costs/design.md §4.

BudgetLineDerivation.title: Budget Line Derivation
BudgetLineDerivation.description: A system-managed bookkeeping row that fingerprints the last monthly amounts KnownCostBudgetWriter wrote to one BudgetLine, so regeneration is idempotent and an operator's own edit to a derived line is detected and respected rather than silently overwritten (design.md §4). Written only by KnownCostBudgetWriter, never by an operator directly. No lifecycle — derived state, not operator-authored configuration.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this derivation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

annualBudgetId.description: FK to the AnnualBudget this derivation's BudgetLine belongs to.
annualBudgetId.title: Annual Budget ID

ledgerGroupId.description: FK to the LedgerGroup this derivation's BudgetLine phases amounts against.
ledgerGroupId.title: Ledger Group ID

sourceType.description: The BudgetLine.source value this derivation wrote.
sourceType.title: Source Type

budgetLineId.description: FK to the BudgetLine object this derivation run created/last upserted.
budgetLineId.title: Budget Line ID

contributingRecurIds.description: Every CashflowRecurring.recurId summed into this line — the audit trail / drill-down surface.
contributingRecurIds.title: Contributing Recur IDs

lastGeneratedMonthlyAmounts.description: The exact cents this derivation last wrote for month01.month12 — the drift-detection fingerprint. Length 12.
lastGeneratedMonthlyAmounts.title: Last Generated Monthly Amounts

lastGeneratedAt.description: Timestamp of the last regeneration run that touched this derivation.
lastGeneratedAt.title: Last Generated At

overridden.description: True once a run detects the live BudgetLine no longer matches lastGeneratedMonthlyAmounts — an operator's own edit, which the writer then leaves alone until the BudgetLine is deleted.
overridden.title: Overridden

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a BudgetLineDerivation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
